title: Nvidia PE falls to 14-year low, but CEO exit and AI worries cloud the bargain
summary: By one of Wall Street's favorite metrics, Nvidia shares look like a bargain. Following a steep drop from its October 6 record high, Nvidia's stock is trading at the equivalent of 12 times expected earnings.
